whatThisIs: East Boston Family Engagement Network offers visits to newborns that include a welcoming gift basket of baby essentials. The visit also includes information about EBFEN and its activities and resources. There may be a total of 7 additional visits if enrolled in the Expanded Welcome Baby program.
whoItHelps: Families with newborns up to 9 months old living in East Boston.
whatToKnow: Welcome Baby visits can be conducted in English, Spanish, Arabic, Portuguese, and Vietnamese.
name: Welcome Baby Visits & Gift Basket
